# Upstream notices

The archive preserves inputs acquired from the three pinned source repositories listed in `data/source_manifest.json`. License notices and their exact acquisition URLs/hashes are in this directory. qiskit-metriq and QASMBench notices come from the same pinned input commits. The Benchpress data-only commit has no license file; the supplied Apache-2.0 notice is from the explicitly recorded upstream main-branch commit. No notice has been invented for the data-only branch, and the archive does not replace upstream terms with its own code/documentation license.
